credit.credit-words: Now Thank We All Our God

WORDS: Martin Rinkart, c.1636; tr. by Catherine Winkworth, 1856; alt. MUSIC: “Nun Danket”; attr. to Johann Crüger*, 1647; har. by Felix Mendelssohn, 1840. Public Domain. *Catherine Winkworth believed Martin Rinkart wrote the tune in 1644.
Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ. 2 Cor. 2:14 O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever. Psa. 136:26
